confidence_notes: Recent Cancún cost indexes support the meal, coffee and beer estimates. The cocktail figure comes from a sparse local index; the wine-glass estimate uses its likely price relationship to local beer because a direct typical glass price was unavailable. Accommodation is a holistic estimate without live listing checks and varies widely between downtown and the Hotel Zone.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use Cancún-specific price data. Accommodation reflects general knowledge of budget lodging in Cancún and the Mexican Caribbean, with no city proxy.
